title: Confirmed SubscribeCOV monitored object request
purpose: Add subscription/state-oriented confirmed-service coverage with multiple interacting fields such as process identifier, monitored object, lifetime, and issue-confirmed flag.
expected_behavior: A BACnet/IP target should parse the frame as a SubscribeCOV request and either establish, renew, reject, or error the subscription depending on local object support and policy.
constraints_preserved: NPDU and confirmed APDU layering preserved
Confirmed service choice 0x05 for SubscribeCOV is directly source-backed
Request body is a conservative standard-style tagged subscription analogue using process identifier, monitored object identifier, confirmed flag, and lifetime
Chosen as stateful coverage because it targets a service with persistent subscription semantics even though the seed itself is a single request
issue_safety_notes: Safe PK-only subscription seed with ordinary values and no issue-specific mutation or replay hazard.
